principle: A Product Twin avatar is not always a mesh. Objects, materials and configurable systems require different digital representations.

geometry_levels.name: Identity only
geometry_levels.description: No geometry. Product exists only as canonical identity + evidence/offers.

geometry_levels.name: Bounding proxy
geometry_levels.description: Verified real-world envelope, dimensions, clearance and anchor/pivot. Simple parametric proxy.

geometry_levels.name: Design proxy
geometry_levels.description: Recognizable low-detail geometry or material representation with verified physical scale and key interfaces.

geometry_levels.name: Render avatar
geometry_levels.description: Render-grade geometry/materials with PBR, correct scale, variants and approved visual likeness.

geometry_levels.name: Specification/BIM avatar
geometry_levels.description: Engineering/specification-grade interfaces, BIM/CAD metadata, clearances and configuration data.

geometry_levels.name: Manufacturing/configuration twin
geometry_levels.description: Manufacturer/configurator-authoritative digital model capable of producing valid configured outputs or manufacturing data.

generation_policy.merchant_model3d: use when identity and rights are verified
generation_policy.ai_reconstruction: allowed only as a non-authoritative visual proxy until exact dimensions and likeness are verified
generation_policy.generic_proxy: allowed for design planning but must never be presented as the exact purchasable product
